title: Writing --- With A Clock
label: ch:fa-with-a-clock
canDo: I can fill in a short practical form in Persian script against a three-minute clock, and I know what this track's A1 writing paper asks for.

payoff.summary: Complete FA-W288-ba-saat: all six form fields in Persian script before the three-minute timer rings, then stop.
payoff.note: This book found no widely used international A1 Persian writing paper, and the SAMFA provider source it checked publishes no CEFR mapping, so the A1 paper is this track's own: 20 minutes, a practical form and a 30 to 40 word message, 60/100 needed on every paper with no averaging. This checkpoint rehearses the form for three minutes and is not that paper.
